scripts.text:
Why would a wasp lay its egg inside a cockroach’s egg case?

A female ensign wasp places one egg inside the case. When her egg hatches, the young wasp feeds on the dozen or more cockroach eggs inside.

The adult is only about a quarter of an inch long. Its back section looks like a tiny signal flag on a thin stalk, giving the ensign wasp its name. The wasp waves that little flag up and down.

If you spot one in your home, you can leave it alone. This wasp doesn’t sting or bite people.

Helping you understand pests. Deep Six Pest Control.
